notes.value: Prolonged-release metoprolol SUCCINATE; keep separate from metoprolol tartrate products. Label strength is the salt: '1 Retardtablette enthält 47,5 mg Metoprololsuccinat (Ph.Eur.)'; product page gives equivalent 38.91 mg metoprolol (not used as label strength). Imprint wording differs between leaflet (A/mO) and product page (A MO); image shows 'A' and 'mO'/'MO' on the scored side but letter case cannot be settled from the photo. Product page 'Anbieter' is Recordati Pharma GmbH, Ulm, which the leaflet lists as 'Mitvertrieb' (co-distributor, Eberhard-Finckh-Str. 55, 89075 Ulm); leaflet Pharmazeutischer Unternehmer is the Italian company. Zul.-Nr. 48563.01.00. ABDATA average: 12.7 x 6.7 x 3.8 mm, mass 223.0 mg. Leaflet packs 30/50/90/100; this PZN = 30 (N1). Version code Z06.
